cells.gaps: No source found says a rule in force classifies government data or requires it to be held in Tunisia; no government contract with data terms is held.
cells.note: The G-Cloud label, in force since 2023 and awarded from July 2024, frames government cloud hosting as a sovereignty goal, so stage 2. The CNI hosts sensitive platforms on its own cloud (TUN-003), but with no rule on state data in force hosting places nothing, so not 3.
